messages:
maria: morning team — quick standup: queue is ~42 open tickets (priority breakdown: P1=1, P2=6, P3=35). I triaged overnight and moved 7 to awaiting-customer. noticed repeat around webhook timeouts for embeddings webhook. tagging @kevin for infra follow-up.

kevin: on it, saw increased 504s from the embed proxy between 01:10-01:35 UTC. root-cause looks like a connection pool exhaustion on the proxy -> spike in retries. i've temporarily increased the pool and set a short retry backoff. watching.

jo: good call. for macros — the webhook retry macro needs a note about transient 504s so CS doesn't escalate. I'll draft a quick macro edit and open a PR.

samir: i handled the P1 (customer-facing billing duplicate charge). resolved, customer refunded, case note + link: https://tickets.example/INC-1138. set status to resolved.

lina: fyi I'm blocked on the embed-split PR review because i need data access to the quantized model logs — @kevin any chance you can grant read to the support role?

kevin: granted support-read to 'support/triage' role for the next 48h. please only use for debugging and delete creds after.

maria: thanks. macro edits needed: 1) add webhook transient 504 guidance; 2) add step to rotate embed proxy on sustained errors; 3) include link to the probe dashboard. who can push the macro change?

jo: i'll do it now. quick note — keep messaging concise: add bullet about expected retry window (<=5m) and escalation to infra if >15m. pushing PR: https://git.example/macros/PR-242

ops-bot: deploy started for PR-242 by jo — rolling out to macros/support (canary).

maria: great. two quick asks: can someone ping eng-runtime about the KV cache eviction spike? noticed errors in 3 tickets referencing degraded chat completions when cache TTL reset. @samir can you collect the ticket IDs and drop in this thread?

samir: tickets: TKT-5512, TKT-5520, TKT-5539. all show similar traces: 'kvcache miss -> cold start latency ~320ms'. I'll attach logs.

kevin: passing to eng-runtime on pager duty. created a short incident note and linked the tickets. eng-runtime, assign to oncall: there's a TTL regression in the caching layer.

maria: last item — today's coverage: am 09:00-13:00 UTC, jo 13:00-17:00 UTC, lina 17:00-21:00 UTC. please post any handoff notes here before swaps. thanks :thumbsup:

jo: noted. pulling a quick list of 5 tickets for my shift triage.

lina: will monitor embed proxy dashboards during my window. if errors persist after kevin's changes, i'll escalate to infra-sre.

kevin: update: embed proxy 504 counts dropped to near-zero after pool bump. will keep open until 12:00 UTC then revert the temp change if stable.

maria: perfect — keep me posted. otherwise no blockers from me.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: daily-triage-summary will post at 08:50 UTC with queue snapshot.
